context: Two teens trade stories about a recent school event
purpose: Teach: あがっ/だす/云う/反面/誇る/著しく/僅か/満たす

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ聞いてよ、文化祭の時さ、うちのクラスの劇で歓声があがって、ほんとに盛り上がったんだよ。
lines.en: Hey listen, at the school festival, cheers went up during our class play and it really got hyped.
lines.style: Excited teen girl sharing recent memory enthusiastically

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジで?俺もそれ見たかった。云うまでもなく、桜のクラスって毎年クオリティ高いって有名じゃん。
lines.en: Seriously? I wanted to see that. Needless to say, your class is famous for top quality every year.
lines.style: Casual teen boy responding with friendly admiration warmly

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも準備期間が僅か二週間しかなくてさ、楽しい反面、徹夜続きでマジしんどかったよ。
lines.en: But we only had two weeks to prep, fun on one hand but the all-nighters were seriously rough.
lines.style: Teen girl venting half-proud half-exhausted tone naturally

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うわ、それキツいな。俺らの体育祭もさ、応援団が走りだすと一気にテンション上がって最高だった。
lines.en: Yikes, brutal. Our sports day was the same, when the cheer squad started running, hype shot up.
lines.style: Teen boy sharing parallel story with energy excitedly

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あ、そういえば後夜祭のステージで、軽音部の演奏がやばすぎて、観客の期待を完全に満たす出来だったよ。
lines.en: Oh right, at the after-party stage, the light music club's performance was insane — completely the kind of show that satisfies the crowd's expectations.
lines.style: Teen girl recalling another highlight casually and vividly

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいなあ、軽音部って毎年クオリティ誇るレベルだよな。来年は俺らも同じくらいやってみたいわ。
lines.en: Nice, the light music club boasts crazy quality every year. Next year I wanna pull off something like that too.
lines.style: Teen boy responding with admiration and resolve genuinely

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、ぜひ来てよ。あ、徹夜のせいで体力が著しく落ちたから、今夜は早く寝るわ。
lines.en: Yeah, definitely come. Oh, my stamina dropped significantly from all the all-nighters, so I'm sleeping early tonight.
lines.style: Teen girl wrapping up with tired wave farewell
